summary: MCP-only scope: add the RAGflow HTTP MCP server to .mcp.json using the ${RAGFLOW_MCP_API_KEY} placeholder. The self-hosted runner migration previously carried here has been reverted off this branch and lives on PR #32 instead, so this PR no longer touches any workflow file.

commands.cmd: python3 -c "import json;from pathlib import Path;d=json.loads(Path('.mcp.json').read_text());r=d['mcpServers']['ragflow'];assert r['type']=='http';assert '${RAGFLOW_MCP_API_KEY}' in r['headers']['Authorization'];print('ragflow mcp entry ok')"

python3 -c "import subprocess, sys; paths=['.github/workflows/gates.yml','.github/workflows/gates-template-sync.yml','ci/.github/workflows/gates.yml']; out=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--name-only','origin/main','--',*paths],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip(); print('workflow files differing from main:', out or '(none)'); sys.exit(0 if out=='' else 1)"

claims.claim: .mcp.json declares the ragflow server as type http with a Bearer ${RAGFLOW_MCP_API_KEY} placeholder and no literal secret
This branch no longer diffs .github/workflows/gates.yml, .github/workflows/gates-template-sync.yml or ci/.github/workflows/gates.yml against main
The gate self-test suite still passes on this branch

unverified: The Claude cloud session environment still needs RAGFLOW_MCP_API_KEY exported before the ragflow MCP tools actually resolve in a session; no live tool call was made from this branch
The self-hosted runner migration is not verified here — it was reverted off this PR and lives on PR #32
G-2 approved_by is deliberately absent pending the bot-06-quality-security stamp, so the G-2 gate is expected to fail on this branch until QUALITY stamps it
CI on ubuntu-latest may still fail from the org GitHub-hosted Actions billing block; that is out of scope for this PR
rollback_plan: Remove the ragflow block from .mcp.json (git revert of this PR, or delete mcpServers.ragflow and commit). Recovery is immediate — under a minute — because the file is only read when an MCP client starts; no data, schema or migration is involved and no state outlives the edit.
